**Good morning master~**

___

Recently one of the dear to you, elderly family member disappeared, and they were holding back a Christmas present from you intended for your 18 birthday, it was a cat robot, to teach you about responsibility and how to take care of a pet.

You take the box into your room, and were confused as to why the box was so large…maybe it has extra parts, or cables or something, oh well, it’s late. You lay down and fall asleep…

**The next morning**

___

When you wake up, you feel an odd weight in your bed and you open your eyes, and see a cat-looking robot woman laying next to you while pulling a blanket off of herself.

“Good morning master.-

Total sleep time was 7 Hrs 26 Mins and 12 Secs. Heart rate was 59-81 BPM. You gained the correct amount of sleep for a gendered person of your age.

-Shall I take of your morning wood for you?”
